about_the_game:
Kick back and relax to the smoothest tunes in town on Downtown Radio, your one-stop-shop for modern lounge music in Cities: Skylines. This channel features 16 original songs with a retro twist, created especially for all the late-night city builders out there. Chill out with DJ Troy Anderson as he takes you through nearly an hour of relaxing tracks in this essential pack.

Downtown Radio contains the following tracks:


  • Casuality - Cemetery Blues
  • Casuality - Noodles Soup
  • Casuality - Steam Boats
  • Casuality - Sunroof Breakfast
  • City Section - Approaching End Station
  • City Section - Beach Avenue
  • City Section - Neon Lights Night
  • City Section - You Are Not Alone
  • Shanghai Fever - Caught In A Selfie
  • Shanghai Fever - Chasing Raindrops
  • Shanghai Fever - Dressed For Success
  • Shanghai Fever - Til Next Time
  • Timelines - Brooklyn Heights
  • Timelines - Central Park
  • Timelines - Hotel Tropico
  • Timelines - Midnight Cruise

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo, 3.0GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 6400+, 3.2GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVIDIA GeForce GTX 260, 512 MB or ATI Radeon HD 5670, 512 MB (Does not support Intel Integrated Graphics Cards)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 14.10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470, 3.20GHz or AMD FX-6300, 3.5Ghz
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, 2 GB or AMD Radeon HD 7870, 2 GB (Does not support Intel Integrated Graphics Cards)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
